model.description: R33.9 INV-A1-4 verb-set half (design fcc9166e4): the model.ts action-bar host (architect 'ModelActionBar') tracks activeDiagramUuid from rb-active-diagram and SPLITS the verb set - UNIT verbs (new/rename/delete) always on a selected modelelement (A3); MEMBERSHIP verbs (add/remove) appended ONLY when a diagram is active, targeting THAT diagram (A1/A2); showActionsForType recomputes on selection AND on rb-active-diagram (A4 IMG_4802/4803 fix). Reuse R33.6.5 ACTIONS_BY_TYPE + wireDrawerActions, no fork.
